summary: Applies the system's icon sizing and accessibility defaults to any SVG component you hand it. The package ships no icon set.
useWhen: rendering any icon inside this design system, from any library — lucide, heroicons, react-icons, your own SVG

useInstead.when: the graphic is a brand mark
you need a coloured status marker with text

guarantees: with `label`, the icon gets `role="img"` and that name
without `label`, it is `aria-hidden` and `focusable="false"` — decoration, never read twice
requires: `label` when the icon carries meaning on its own — an icon-only button, a standalone status marker
notes: Omit `label` for an icon beside a visible text label. The text already names it.

antiPatterns.why: the button's own text names it; the labelled icon makes it announce twice

antiPatterns.do: a `size` rung, or omit `size` to inherit the surrounding font size
antiPatterns.why: inheriting is what lets an icon sit correctly inside a Button without the Button knowing about it
the ladder shifted in 2026-08: `xs` is 14, and `2xs` is the old 12. This raises no type error

sizes.note: The rungs map one-to-one onto the Semantics `icon-size/*` tokens. Any CSS length is also accepted for a one-off.
